_doc: Human-labeled gold set for LLM relation classification (issue #285 step 2). 29 LLM-decided edges from the published ViT + FA lineage, each labeled by hand against the rubric in docs/design/08-lineage-roadmap.md §関係種別ラベルの定義. Used by paperpilot/scripts/eval_relation_prompt.py to compute macro-F1 of the current vs proposed prompts. Confidence: high = unambiguous from titles + abstracts, medium = a defensible alternative label exists. Source: docs/themes/{vision-transformer,flash-attention}/lineage.json edges with provenance=llm as of 2026-06-10.

parent.title: Feature Pyramid Networks for Object Detection
